name: Monochrome Studio — Refined Dark Portfolio System
description: A minimal, high-contrast dark design system inspired by premium fractional-designer portfolios. Pure-black canvas, soft charcoal cards, oversized neo-grotesque display type, and quiet gray supporting text. The personality is calm, confident, and editorial — luxury through restraint, not decoration.

accent.note: Color is used almost exclusively inside product imagery (warm reds, soft purples, mint greens). The UI chrome itself stays strictly monochrome.

fontStack.note: Geist — a modern, neutral neo-grotesque (close to Söhne/Helvetica) that reads cleaner and more contemporary than Arial. The SIZE and tight tracking carry the personality. Numbers (01–06) feel near-monospace and muted.

spacing.rhythm: Very generous vertical whitespace between sections. Content breathes. Section labels sit far above their content.

nav.layout: Fixed/space-between. Name on the left, single circular outline button (hamburger / =) on the right.
nav.circleButton: 36px circle, 1px subtle border, transparent fill, centered glyph in tertiary gray.

projectCard.content: Centered floating product render (soft drop shadow), then title + gray subtitle anchored bottom-left.
projectCard.layout: Horizontal scroll row, ~5 cards visible, last one bleeds off the right edge.
projectCard.hover: Background lifts to #1d1d1d; render scales 1.03 and shadow deepens. ~400ms ease.

pill.shape: Fully rounded, 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.16), transparent fill with faint top-light inner gradient.
pill.hover: Border brightens to 0.24, subtle fill rgba(255,255,255,0.04).

approachItem.layout: 3-column grid. Each item: muted number (01) + paragraph with bold white lead sentence followed by secondary-gray detail.

logoRow.style: Single row of client wordmarks at ~35% opacity (tertiary gray), evenly spaced, last bleeds off edge.

testimonialCard.shape: Tall rounded card (radius 24px), background #171717 with a soft radial highlight at top-center (cardGlowTop) fading to flat.
testimonialCard.content: Large quote in onCardQuote, then footer row: client wordmark (tertiary) left, circular avatar right.
testimonialCard.layout: Horizontal row, 3 visible, third bleeds off the right edge.

metaBlock.layout: Two-column rows: uppercase tracked label (tertiary) left, value right. Used for TEAM (avatar stack), SERVICES (pills), DATE.

motion.principles: Slow, soft, premium. Nothing bouncy. 350–500ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1).
motion.pageLoad: Staggered upward fade for hero line, then card row. animation-delay cascade ~60ms apart.
motion.hover: Gentle background lifts and 1.02–1.05 scale on imagery. Borders brighten on pills/cards.

principles: Pure black is the canvas; charcoal #171717 is the only elevation. Never introduce gray gradients into chrome — only into product imagery.
Type does the heavy lifting: oversized, tightly tracked neo-grotesque headlines against quiet gray supporting copy.
Color appears ONLY inside product renders and content, never in buttons, links, or backgrounds.
Whitespace is a feature. Sections are separated by large vertical gaps; labels float well above their content.
Cards and rows intentionally bleed off the right edge to imply horizontal continuation.
Contrast hierarchy is strict: #f5f5f5 primary, #a0a0a0 secondary, #6e6e6e tertiary, #4a4a4a quaternary.
